patchouli.chaosworld.book.landing: Welcome to Chaos World!$(br)This guide will help you understand nearly everything in this modpack.$(br)$(br)$(l)Version:$(l) $(#AA00AA)1.0.0
patchouli.chaosworld.category.index.desc: Getting started guide for Chaos World.
patchouli.chaosworld.category.worldgen.d: How to enter each dimension, its environment and its resources.
patchouli.chaosworld.entry.worldgen.dime: $(l)What this chapter covers$(br)Beyond the Overworld, Nether and End, the pack opens seven more dimensions, from the Twilight Forest to the nuclear wasteland. Each is entered differently.
patchouli.chaosworld.entry.worldgen.dim_: Outer Lands
$(l)Overview$(br)The Outer Lands sit at the end of the arcane path: labyrinth rooms are stamped straight into the dimension, with no natural terrain at all.
$(l)Getting there$(br)In Overworld plains or forests, find an obelisk site, put four Eldritch Eyes into the Eldritch Altar and cast at it with a wand.
$(l)Prerequisites$(br)Eyes are infused only after the Oculus research. Three eyes in the altar already wake its guardians.
$(l)Labyrinth$(br)Rooms hold treasure, libraries and nests; a Runed Tablet is the key to each maze. Beds explode here and respawn anchors fail: portals are the only way in and out.
Nuclear Wasteland
$(l)Overview$(br)A red wasteland, searing hot and rainless, covered in wasteland earth and scattered glowing mushrooms. No villages, no structures.
$(l)Getting there$(br)The wasteland biome spawns portal lakes, and that biome also appears in the Overworld. Step into the wasteland portal; it has no crafting recipe.
$(l)Notes$(br)This pack disables radiation by default, so nothing accumulates here. Feral ghouls still spawn in the dark, and there is no natural water.
Twilight Forest
$(l)Overview$(br)A dimension buried under giant trees, with over twenty biomes from forests and swamps to glaciers and highlands. Its terrain and time are its own.
$(l)Getting there$(br)Find a pool ringed by flowers and throw a Twilight Catalyst into the water. The pack removed diamonds from the activator list.
$(l)Progression$(br)Naga, Lich, Minoshroom, Hydra, plus two side chains: Yeti to Snow Queen, and Knights to Ur-Ghast. All three chains must be finished before the highlands open.
$(l)Hazards$(br)Dark Forest blinds, Swamp starves, Fire Swamp scorches, Glaciers freeze, and the highlands rain acid over thorns. Until the matching progression is done, these biomes hurt you.
$(l)Resources$(br)Ironwood, steeleaf, knightmetal and fiery ingots are local materials. A Magic Map shows everything; Maze and Ore Maps find mazes and ores.
Mining Dimension
$(l)Overview$(br)A flat dimension: end stone, netherrack, deepslate and stone stacked in layers, topped with dirt and grass. No lakes, no structures.
$(l)Getting there$(br)Craft a Teleport Pad from 4 ATM nuggets and an ender pearl, place it in the Overworld, empty both hands and shift-right-click.
$(l)Resources$(br)ATM ore spawns between Y 65 and 129 and needs a netherite pickaxe. Vanilla ores keep their layers; AlltheOres adds more metals. There is no water here.
The Other
$(l)Overview$(br)Eternal midnight, and water evaporates. Ancient stone terrain split into soul sand valleys, crimson and warped forests, and deserts.
$(l)Getting there$(br)Place a Teleport Pad in the Nether, empty both hands and shift-right-click. Repeat on the pad in the Other to return.
$(l)Structures$(br)Ancient pyramids in the soul sand valleys guard the Piglich; dungeons and piglin villages wait underground.
$(l)Resources$(br)Vibranium ore and ATM ore sit deep here and need an ATM pickaxe. It is very hostile — bring netherite gear.
The Beyond
$(l)Overview$(br)The Beyond is pure void: not a single block from top to bottom, only sky.
$(l)Getting there$(br)Place a Teleport Pad in the End and shift-right-click empty-handed. A pad spawns under you, and it drops nothing when broken.
$(l)Warning$(br)No ores, structures or mobs. Do not break the pad — it is your only foothold.
The Aether
$(l)Overview$(br)Floating islands in eternal daylight, with no rain. Four skyroot biomes exist here; the void waits below.
$(l)Getting there$(br)Frame a portal with glowstone on a vertical plane, then pour a water bucket inside. Your first entry grants a starter kit.
$(l)Dungeons$(br)Bronze, silver, then gold. Bronze lies inside the islands, silver on the surface, gold underground; each boss drops its key.
$(l)Bosses$(br)$(li)The Slider: only pickaxes break it$(li)Valkyrie Queen: bring 10 Victory Medals$(li)Sun Spirit: when it falls, the sun sets
$(l)Survival$(br)Non-Aether tools are slowed. Cold aerclouds and parachutes soften falls; fall off an island and you return to the Overworld. Beds and water work.

patchouli.chaosworld.category.biomes.des: Where the new and custom biomes come from.
patchouli.chaosworld.entry.ores.overview: $(l)What this chapter covers$(br)Ores come from many mods; AlltheOres unifies identical metals into one item.$(br2)For any material, search it in JEI to see where it comes from.
patchouli.chaosworld.entry.structures.ov: $(l)What this chapter covers$(br)Large structures come from Cataclysm, Ice and Fire, Twilight Forest and the Aether.$(br2)A Structure Compass locates them; the world map shows what you explored.
patchouli.chaosworld.entry.biomes.overvi: $(l)What this chapter covers$(br)New biomes are added through TerraBlender and Lithostitched, and coexist with vanilla ones.$(br2)The pack also has one custom biome: chaosworld_core:twilight_enclave.
patchouli.chaosworld.entry.modpack_overv: $(#FFAA00)Chaos World$(#000000) is a large modpack.$(br)$(br)Here, you will experience:$(li)Deeply customized tech production lines$(li)Unique custom items and machines$(li)Challenging progression paths
$(l)Main Mods:$(l)$(li)Applied Energistics 2 (AE2)$(li)ProjectE$(br)$(br)Browse the left sidebar for more content.
